newsitem.title: USA: Chateau, ROC buy mobile home parks.
newsitem.headline: Chateau, ROC buy mobile home parks.

text.p: Chateau Properties Inc and ROC Communities Inc said on Wednesday they bought six mobile home communities from Oakwood Homes for $21.2 million in cash.
The companies said in a statement the purchases were made through a 50-50 joint venture, and that ROC separately purchased one additional community from Oakwood.

The six communities had capacity for a total of 2,700 homesites, the companies said. Of these, 1,400 were fully developed, 550 were leased and 850 were available for lease. The companies said 1,300 were subject to future development.
ROC bought an additional community adjacent to a community it already owned for $1.9 million in cash. It had 320 sites, about half of which were developed, the companies said.

"We are acquiring properties in six different states, yet all of the communities fall within existing operational regions, which will allow us to integrate them smoothly and take advantage of economies of sale," ROC President and Chief Executive Officer Gary McDaniel said in a statement.
Chateau signed a definitive agreement to merge with ROC in July and revised that agreement last month.
